scope: Explicit offline model/reference-recording export; no GUI, live-camera recording or visual-perfection certification.

full_recording_export.input_kind: User-supplied reference recording and stable local model/profile snapshot.

clock: Offline source frame indices / reported FPS; real-time interpolation delay is zero.
safety_coverage: Source/model/profile paths and existing outputs protected.
Staged-file publication is exclusive and rolls back its own links on collision.
Interrupted exports, changed inputs and reordered observations publish no completed outputs.
Native inference stays in an owned child with response/shutdown bounds.
Only numeric observations cross to rendering; no raw input or landmark dump.
concurrent_work_preserved: Pre-existing concurrent retarget.py changes and test_rig_twist.py are included in the tested tree, not attributed to CLI export.
A stable local model/profile copy isolates the full render from ongoing external authoring.
Separately authored limb-twist and head-handover tasks were retained without changing their implementation or task identifiers.
